Sara L.: midday handoff — heads up, swapping primary early. I'm on a client call starting 12:10 PT so I'll hand off primary to Michael C. at ~12:15 PT. Devon P. will be secondary. There's a potential coverage conflict 15:30–16:15 PT (calendar overlap) where only secondary might be fully available. Please ack and shout if you can't cover.

OncallRotationsBot: Rotation change requested by Sara L. — please confirm. Run `oncall rotations confirm 1826000000` or visit https://redwood.internal/oncall to approve.

Michael C.: ack — I'll take primary at 12:15 PT. Switching phone/PD settings now. Any active incidents I should know about?

IncidentBot: Current incidents: none P1/P2. Active alerts: streaming-api-high-latency (SEV3) — noise over last 2 hours, watchers notified.

Sara L.: no P1s. streaming-api metric spikes in eu-west last 2 hours; keep an eye on tail latency and consumer lag. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-api#mitigation (see quick mitigations).

Carmen: I can cover the 15:30–16:15 PT window if things look risky — ping @Carmen and I'll take pages then.

Devon P.: noted. I'll stay at my desk during the gap. Quick ops reminder if model workers OOM: restart the worker pool — snippet in runbook.

Michael C.: can you paste the exact restart command and the runbook pointer here? want to have it in thread.

Sara L.: restart snippet: ```ssh gpu-ops 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference-worker'``` — that restarts the pool without touching the control plane. Full runbook link again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-api#mitigation. If mem leaks recur, trigger a rolling restart per runbook.

Michael C.: ok thanks. I'll flip the PD primary badge now. Sara, please post the final rotation command when you're ready.

Sara L.: executing rotation now: ```oncall set --primary "Michael C." --secondary "Devon P." --until "2026-03-14T23:59:00Z"  # PT times```

OncallRotationsBot: Rotation updated. Primary: Michael C. (since 2026-03-14T19:15Z). Secondary: Devon P. (until 2026-03-15T07:59Z). Change logged by Sara L.

Michael C.: ack :thumbsup: checklist for whoever is primary: 1) pager on + ringer up, 2) confirm PD escalations, 3) read runbook link above, 4) for SEV escalate DM Carmen + trigger PD all-hands if active.

Carmen: I'll be watching for escalations during the gap and can jump in. DM me if anything looks like P2+.

IncidentBot: Reminder: paging policy — P1 pages escalate to two people then all-hands. See https://redwood.internal/policies/paging for details.

Sara L.: leaving now — Michael C. takes over at 12:15 PT. I'll be reachable via DM for ~30m. Thanks all.

Michael C.: taking over — thanks Sara.
